from common import *
import gc,traceback,shutil
import numpy as np,pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb
from backtest.scripts.maintenance import experiment_harness as native
from backtest.scripts.train import train_regime_arm as tr
from backtest.models import regime_adapt as models
from objective import members,RegretGradient,MixedMetric,bounds

HSTATE=BASE/'docs/harness-state.json'
def event(typ,**kw):
    s=native.inspect_state(HSTATE,repo_root=ROOT,check_drift=typ=='fit_start')
    return native.append_event(HSTATE,dict(type=typ,**kw),expected_revision=s['revision'],repo_root=ROOT)
def prepare():
    m=read(VALID)['blocks']['frame'];p=VALID.parent/m['path'];check({**m,'path':str(p)})
    db=pd.read_pickle(p);frame=db['frame'];trd=db['tradable'];del db
    frame=frame.loc[frame.index.get_level_values('datetime')<=pd.Timestamp('2026-07-23')]
    trd=trd.reindex(frame.index);ref=read(PREVEX/'docs/weekly-h5-four-T-s42-a1-inputs.json')
    assert tr.frame_signature(frame)==ref['validation'] and tr.frame_signature(trd)==ref['tradable']
    raw=frame['label','LABEL0'].astype('float64');n=raw.groupby(level='datetime').transform('size').to_numpy()
    r=raw.groupby(level='datetime').rank(method='average').to_numpy()
    g=((20*r).astype('int64')-1)//(2*n);labels=np.array(read(TARGET_AUDIT)['h5']['scores_float32'],dtype=np.float32)
    frame['label','LABEL0']=labels[g]
    dt=frame.index.get_level_values('datetime');days=pd.DatetimeIndex(dt.unique()).sort_values();reg=day_labels().reindex(days)
    out={}
    for v in STYLES:
        own=np.flatnonzero(reg.eq(v).to_numpy());prior=own[own>=5]-5
        loc=np.union1d(own,prior);take=dt.isin(days[loc])
        valid=frame.iloc[np.flatnonzero(take)]
        ix=valid.index;dd=ix.get_level_values('datetime');prev=np.searchsorted(loc,loc-5)
        ok=np.isin(loc-5,loc);prev[~ok]=-1
        context=pd.DataFrame(dict(raw=raw.reindex(ix),tradable=trd.reindex(ix).fillna(False).astype(bool),own=dd.isin(days[own]),prev=pd.Series(prev,index=days[loc]).reindex(dd).values),index=ix)
        assert (valid.loc[context.own].index.get_level_values('datetime').nunique()==len(own)) and tr.frame_signature(valid.loc[context.own])==read(LAST/'docs/validation-grade.json')['styles'][v]['frame']
        assert np.isfinite(context.raw).all() and valid.index.is_monotonic_increasing
        path=TMP/f'valid-{v}.pkl';pd.to_pickle((valid,context),path)
        out[v]=dict(file=fingerprint(path),scored_days=len(own),context_days=len(loc),rows=len(valid),exact_previous_own_frame=True)
    write(BASE/'docs/validation.json',out)

class Choice:
    def __init__(self):self.best=0;self.score=-np.inf;self.ended=None
    def step(self,r,score):
        if self.ended is None:
            if score>self.score:self.score=score;self.best=r
            if r-self.best>=50 or r==200:self.ended=r

def fit_style(v):
    prep=read(PREVEX/'configs/prepared-inputs.json');sub=prep['subsets'][v];check(sub['target'])
    y=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/sub['target']['path']);source=read(TARGET_AUDIT)['h5']['raw_old'];check(source)
    raw=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/source['path']).reindex(y.index);assert isinstance(raw,pd.Series) and np.isfinite(raw).all()
    n=raw.groupby(level='datetime').transform('size').to_numpy()
    bins=((20*raw.groupby(level='datetime').rank().to_numpy()).astype('int64')-1)//(2*n)
    assert np.array_equal(np.asarray(read(TARGET_AUDIT)['h5']['scores_float32'],dtype=np.float32)[bins],y.to_numpy())
    fm=read(FEATURE);parts=[]
    for yy in range(2004,2021):
        b=fm['blocks'][str(yy)];p=FEATURE.parent/b['path'];check({**b,'path':str(p)})
        f=pd.read_pickle(p);pos=y.index[y.index.get_level_values('datetime').year==yy];assert pos.isin(f.index).all()
        parts.append(f.reindex(pos))
    x=pd.concat(parts);del parts,f;gc.collect()
    assert x.index.equals(y.index)
    old=read(LAST/'docs'/f'weekly-h5-rankic-{v}-s42-a1.json');sha=hash_array(x.to_numpy());assert sha==old['features_sha256'] and hash_array(y.to_numpy())==sub['label_sha256']
    weights=models.compose_day_weights(x.index,pd.Series(np.ones(len(x))),models.load_day_weights(str(WEIGHTS))).to_numpy();assert hash_array(weights)==sub['weight_sha256']
    objective=RegretGradient(x.index,y.to_numpy(),raw.to_numpy(),weights)
    vr=read(BASE/'docs/validation.json')[v];check(vr['file']);valid,context=pd.read_pickle(TMP/f'valid-{v}.pkl')
    metric=MixedMetric(valid,context,objective.scale)
    write(BASE/'docs'/f'panel-{v}.json',dict(train_rows=len(x),train_dates=len(objective.windows),features_sha=sha,weights_sha=sub['weight_sha256'],raw_sha=hash_array(raw.to_numpy()),raw_source=source,exact_grades=True,es_scale=objective.scale,valid=vr))
    for seed in SEEDS:
        for mix in (False,True):
            typ='mixed' if mix else 'ordinary';basejob=f'{typ}-{v}-s{seed}';prog=read(PROGRESS)
            if all(any(j['variant']==a+'-'+v and j['seed']==seed and j['status']=='succeeded' for j in prog['jobs']) for a in (['joint','train'] if mix else ['stop'])):continue
            s=native.inspect_state(HSTATE,repo_root=ROOT,check_drift=False)
            job=basejob+'-a'+str(1+sum(k.startswith(basejob+'-a') for k in s['jobs']))
            event('fit_start',exp_id=EID,job_id=job,seed=seed,label_horizon=5,command=[sys.executable,__file__,'fit',v,typ,str(seed)])
            try:
                train=lgb.Dataset(x.to_numpy(),label=y.to_numpy(),weight=weights)
                val=lgb.Dataset(valid['feature'].to_numpy(),label=valid['label','LABEL0'].to_numpy(),reference=train)
                p=dict(tr.FROZEN_SINGLE_KWARGS);p['early_stopping_rounds']=50
                shell=models.RegimeSingleLGBMModel(protocol_id='regime-adapt-v1',valid_dates_csv=None,day_weights_csv=str(WEIGHTS),seed=seed,es_metric='daily_rank_ic',**p)
                params={**shell.params,'metric':'None','objective':objective if mix else 'mse'}
                selections={k:Choice() for k in ['mixed','ic']};hist=[];started=time.time()
                def evaluate(pred,_):
                    row=metric.compute(pred);rv=metric.compute(pred,reverse=True)
                    errs={k:abs(rv[k]-row[k]) for k in ('mixed','ic','net_h5','turnover')}
                    assert max(errs.values())<1e-12 and row['n_ic']==row['n'] and row['n']==vr['scored_days']
                    hist.append(dict(**row,reverse_mixed=rv['mixed'],reverse_ic=rv['ic'],max_reverse_error=max(errs.values())))
                    return [('mixed',row['mixed'],True),('ic',row['ic'],True)]
                def end(env):
                    r=env.iteration+1
                    for k,sel in selections.items():sel.step(r,hist[-1][k])
                    # Keep the common trajectory through both predeclared stopping points.
                    if all(sel.ended for sel in selections.values()):raise lgb.callback.EarlyStopException(r-1,env.evaluation_result_list)
                end.before_iteration=False;end.order=30
                model=lgb.train(params,train,num_boost_round=200,valid_sets=[val],valid_names=['valid'],feval=evaluate,callbacks=[end],keep_training_booster=True)
                histpath=BASE/'docs'/f'{job}-trace.json';write(histpath,dict(rows=hist,choices={k:vars(s) for k,s in selections.items()},elapsed_seconds=time.time()-started))
                if not mix:
                    reference=read(LAST/'docs'/f'weekly-h5-rankic-{v}-s{seed}-a1.json')
                    rehist=reference['rounds'];nshared=min(len(hist),len(rehist));err=max(abs(hist[i]['ic']-rehist[i]['rankic']) for i in range(nshared))
                    write(BASE/'docs'/f'{job}-bridge.json',dict(archived_rankic_best=reference['best_iteration'],same_trajectory_rankic_best=selections['ic'].best,rounds_compared=nshared,max_rankic_difference=err))
                receipts=[]
                for a,k in ([('joint','mixed'),('train','ic')] if mix else [('stop','mixed')]):
                    choice=selections[k];arm=a+'-'+v;sess=f'h5mix_20261114_{a}_{v.lower()}_s{seed}';id_=arm+f'-s{seed}'
                    reversed_choice=Choice()
                    for r,row in enumerate(hist,1):reversed_choice.step(r,row['reverse_'+k])
                    assert reversed_choice.best==choice.best and reversed_choice.ended==choice.ended
                    shell.model=lgb.Booster(model_str=model.model_to_string(num_iteration=choice.best));assert shell.model.num_trees()==choice.best
                    shell.model.best_iteration=choice.best;shell.es_metric='mixed_top3_rankic' if k=='mixed' else 'daily_rank_ic'
                    shell.rankic_evals_result=[dict(es_metric=shell.es_metric,best_iteration=choice.best,best_score=choice.score,valid_days=vr['scored_days'],evaluated_iterations=choice.ended,early_stopping_rounds=50,num_boost_round=200)]
                    summary=dict(model='single',seed=seed,arm='m0',label_horizon=5,label_expr='Ref($close,-6)/Ref($close,-1)-1',es_metric=shell.es_metric,es_valid_source='eval_window',training_objective=typ,es_scope=v,rankic_evals=shell.rankic_evals_result,shared_fit=job)
                    session=tr.save_session('m0',seed,sess,shell,summary);meta=read(session/'meta.json');meta.update(provider_uri=str(PROVIDER),owner_experiment=EID);write(session/'meta.json',meta)
                    mf=fingerprint(session/'run_01/artifacts_root/artifacts/trained_model')
                    out=BASE/'docs'/f'{id_}.json';write(out,dict(job_id=id_,fit=job,model=mf,session=sess,best=choice.best,stopped=choice.ended,score_at_best=hist[choice.best-1],reverse_best=reversed_choice.best,trace=fingerprint(histpath),es_scale=objective.scale))
                    receipts.extend([str(out),mf['path']]);prog['jobs'].append(dict(seed=seed,variant=arm,job_id=id_,fit=job,session=sess,status='succeeded'))
                event('fit_result',job_id=job,outcome='succeeded',evidence=[str(histpath),*receipts]);write(PROGRESS,prog)
                print(job,[(k,c.best,c.ended) for k,c in selections.items()],'secs',round(time.time()-started),flush=True)
                del train,val,model,shell;gc.collect()
            except BaseException:
                f=BASE/'docs'/f'{job}-failure.json';write(f,dict(traceback=traceback.format_exc()));event('fit_result',job_id=job,outcome='failed',evidence=[str(f)]);raise

def execute(args,name):
    with (BASE/'docs'/name).open('a') as f:subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-u',*map(str,args)],stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,cwd=ROOT,check=True)
def pipeline():
    for p in ['common','initialize','run','infer','evaluate','objective','audit']:save_source(TMP/f'{p}.py')
    execute([TMP/'audit.py'],'preflight.log')
    if not (BASE/'docs/validation.json').exists():execute([__file__,'prepare'],'prepare.log')
    for v in ['P','T','D','F']:execute([__file__,'fit',v],f'train-{v}.log')
    for yy in range(2020,2027):
        if not (BASE/'docs'/f'inference-{yy}.json').is_file():execute([TMP/'infer.py',yy],f'infer-{yy}.log')
    for a in VARIANTS:
        if not (BASE/'metrics'/f'{a}.json').is_file():execute([TMP/'evaluate.py',a],f'eval-{a}.log')
if __name__=='__main__':
    if len(sys.argv)==1:pipeline()
    elif sys.argv[1]=='prepare':prepare()
    elif sys.argv[1]=='fit':fit_style(sys.argv[2])
